// ABOUT: Prettier auto-formatting for TypeScript, JavaScript, and web files
// USAGE: Copy the PostToolUse section into your settings.json hooks. The matcher is the tool name (Edit|Write); prettier skips files it can't parse, so one hook covers every supported type.
